sloka: रुद्धा चान्तःपुरे गुप्ता त्वच्चित्ता त्वत्परायणा ।रक्षिता राक्षसीसङ्घैर्विकृतैर्घोरदर्शनैः ।। ६.१२१.९ ।।
transliteration: ruddhā cāntaḥpure guptā tvaccittā tvatparāyaṇā ।rakṣitā rākṣasīsaṅghairvikṛtairghoradarśanaiḥ ।। 6.121.9 ।।

translations.english: " Although Mythili was tempted, threatened also, she had set her mind on you only and not thought of that Rakshasa."
